name: Urban Green
source:
Urban Green is a romantic visual novel about love, life and loserdom. Players will take the role of Jack Sanner, a downwardly mobile, directionless young man who’s just moved to a new city to start a new job at the non-profit environmentalist start-up Urban Green. It’s a chance to finally get his life together, do something that matters with his time. Or, so he thinks…

Along the way, he’ll meet four very different women whose lives have landed them in similar circumstances: the bright and irrepressible Caroline, the cynical and sarcastic Beck, the timid and focused Olivia, and the mature Aaliyah. Jack will work with these women, get to know them, butt heads with them, and potentially, if he makes the right choices, fall in love with one of them. But that’s never the end of the story.

With nine endings to discover, over twenty-five hand-drawn CG backgrounds, a custom-made lofi soundtrack and four full-length, completely distinct story paths depending on the character Jack pursues, Urban Green is a labor of love, and one that we are so excited to share with you. It’s a story for our time, a story about ennui, mental health, and human connection, about getting what you want versus getting what you need, and about having the bravery to live a good life in a world that can often seem out to thwart you at every turn.
